en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a long wooden building with a gabled roof, identified as a museum. In front or alongside the building is a large whale skeleton or similar large marine skeleton structure arranged in an arching display. The ground around the building is bare earth. Printed red captions in Russian and German appear at the top, and there is a publisher line in Russian at the bottom right, plus a handwritten inscription along the bottom edge.
